author: SavageAmericans
body:
As many of you know there has recently been public beta testing of the new Omega Update. I want you to rate it out of 10 based on your opinion, and also add reasons why you rated it what you did.

I rate the Omega Update 10/10

1. The Lobby: The new lobby looks amazing and no longer takes at least 10 seconds to download terrain also there are hidden features and parkour

2. The Features: First of all there is now friends, blood, and toggling other things. There is also /msg now :)

3. The Gamemodes: They added SG, CTW, and other cool games

Also there doesn't seem to be many bugs except some in SG which is expected since it's new. I am sure the bugs will be fixed and the server will be in my opinion the best Minecraft server out there <3

+They are working on an Avicus app

replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body: Yeah, many. I'll list a few, the SG maps had really annoying traps that would hold people but not kill them, at a point 3/5 of the tributes were all trapped. Also in walls a lot of players were trapped underground once the walls dropped. These are two of the major ones there were also others. On the upside however, despite these glitches the game-play was extremely fun. I don't believe I have heard one negative review of the testing. Also this is just testing, the entire point of it is to identify and fix bugs. :) I'm very positive for the Omega update.
